chunks: We were told by Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh, from his paternal uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Ibn Maskan, from Abu Baseer, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Let them not deceive you regarding the Asr prayer, regardless of what they deceive you about in other matters; pray it while the sun is white and pure.' For indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said: 'The one whose family and property are perished is the one who wastes the Asr prayer.' I said: 'And what is the one whose family and property are perished?' He said: 'He will have neither family nor property in Paradise.' I said: 'And what is its wasting?' He said: 'He leaves it, by Allah, until it yellows or disappears.'

key_terms.الْمَوْتُورُ: The one whose family/wealth are perished/lost
key_terms.تَصْفَارَ: It yellows (referring to the sun's color change before sunset)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of wasting the Asr prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the spiritual peril of neglecting the Asr prayer to the concept of the 'perished' (al-Mawtūr), warning that such negligence leads to the loss of one's family and wealth in the Hereafter. He defines this specific neglect as delaying the prayer until the sun turns yellow or sets completely, a detail that highlights the critical window of time for this obligatory act. This teaching underscores the Asr prayer's unique role in maintaining spiritual vigilance against worldly deception, a theme reinforced by the Quranic oath to the declining day.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ali Majilawayh, from his paternal uncle, Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasem, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Kufi, from Ali bin Nu’man, from Ibn Maskan, from Abu Baseer, that he said:

Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, said: Regardless how much they deceive you in anything, let them not deceive you with regards to the afternoon (prayer); pray it while the sun is white and pure, for indeed, the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: The one whose family and property are perished is the one who wastes the afternoon prayer. I said: And what is the one whose family and property are perished? He said: He will neither have family nor property in Paradise. I said: And what is it to waste it? He said: That he leaves it, by Allah, until it yellows or disappears.
